description: This Java source file defines a final class ImmutableMetadataBuilder which implements the MetadataBuilder interface. It provides a mutable builder pattern with a fluent API to construct an ImmutableMetadata object, encapsulating JSON object creation and manipulation functionalities, including setting, removing, and streaming JSON fields. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.metadata package.

classes.name: ImmutableMetadataBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ImmutableMetadata instances with a fluent, mutable API that manipulates underlying JSON objects.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty instance of MetadataBuilder.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new MetadataBuilder initialized with values from a given JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field in the JSON object with various overloads for different data types, possibly conditional via Predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field from the JSON object by key or field definition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JSON fields from an iterable collection of JsonField objects with an optional Predicate filter.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON object is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the JSON object.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of JsonField objects from the JSON object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableMetadata instance encapsulating the current JSON object state.
